purpose: Refuse detected Windows reparse points during Win64 FLTK source archive creation.
change: The creator checks the selected root attributes and refuses enumerated children with FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT. This prevents traversal through reparse points that Windows reports to those APIs.

reparse_probe.finding: Wine's Z: mapped host symlink was not reported as FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT; the GUI archived the outside target bytes. This does not qualify native Windows reparse behavior.

scope_limits: The ordinary Wine regression does not exercise Windows reparse-point refusal.
The Wine symlink probe fails because Wine exposes the host symlink as an ordinary file; native Windows reparse behavior remains unqualified.
A reparse-point substitution between the attribute check and file open remains a Windows source check/use race.
